Summary by CodeRabbit

Release Notes

  • New Features

    • Added RocketKV sparse attention algorithm for optimized KV cache compression and improved generation efficiency.
    • Introduced a modular KV cache compression framework to support multiple sparse attention methods with lifecycle coordination.

  • Bug Fixes

    • Fixed integer casting in sparse attention kernel computations to prevent overflow issues.

  • Improvements

    • Enhanced sparse attention backend routing and configuration system to support behavior-layer sparse methods.

Description

Adds a behavior-layer sparse-attention framework and its first concrete method,
a KVCacheManagerV2-migrated RocketKV selected via algorithm="rocketkv",
with chunked-prefill support.

Framework. A KVCacheBehaviorCoordinator (registered as a
BaseResourceManager) owns one BaseKVCacheCompressionExecutor per axis
(sparse / storage) and translates PyExecutor's
prepare_resources / update_resources / free_resources callbacks into 6
lifecycle hooks (on_request_init, on_context_attention, on_context_end,
on_generation_attention, on_generation_step_end, on_request_finish). This
lets a method update on its own cadence (per-step / phase-boundary / periodic)
without forking the attention kernel or the cache manager. Executors hold
KVCacheManagerV2 as a tool and never subclass it. The footprint outside
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/ is limited to coordinator/
executor wiring: an AttentionMetadata.coordinator field, the hook call site
in TrtllmAttention.forward (gated on coordinator presence), a
KV_CACHE_BEHAVIOR_COORDINATOR resource-manager type, and coordinator
construction in _util.py / model_engine.py.

RocketKV (algorithm="rocketkv"). Two-stage algorithm on the hooks:
Stage I = SnapKV-style physical eviction at prefill end plus a per-page KT
landmark cache; Stage II = query-aware HSA sparse decode. The KT pool is
V2-managed through a declarative BufferConfig (shares the K/V block index);
in-kernel int64 block-index addressing avoids long-context / large-batch
overflow. Chunked prefill is supported for single and multiple concurrent
requests.

Backward compatibility. The existing algorithm="rocket" method is fully
retained and remains selectable; it routes through its original cache-manager
subclass path and is untouched by this PR. The Pydantic discriminator selects
between them ("rocket" → existing path, "rocketkv" → this framework). The
default sparse-attention-off path is unchanged.

Perf & accuracy are aligned with the existing rocket path (Llama-3.1-8B-
Instruct, B200, on top of current main):

metric rocket rocketkv (this PR)
Throughput, 16K input / bs16 1076 tok/s 1097 tok/s (+1.9%)
MMLU (5-shot) 71.49 71.49 (== dense / non-chunked)
GSM8K 45.25 43.75 (within sampling noise; dense baseline same)

Throughput is on par (marginally faster); the KV-cache delta is the Stage-I KT
landmark pool that enables Stage-II query-aware decode. Accuracy matches the
dense and non-chunked baselines, and the path was stress-tested to 64K context
/ bs32 / 32× compression with zero illegal-memory-access.

Test Coverage

  • tests/unittest/_torch/attention/sparse/test_behavior_coordinator.py (new) —
    coordinator construction/mutex, 6-hook dispatch order, resource-manager
    fan-out, AttentionMetadata.coordinator wiring.
  • tests/unittest/_torch/attention/sparse/test_rocketkv_pipeline.py (new) —
    config discriminator (rocket vs rocketkv), factory dispatch, executor
    hook/capability contract.
  • tests/unittest/_torch/attention/sparse/test_rocketkv.py — end-to-end NIAH
    accuracy for non-chunked and chunked (single / multi-request) prefill.

All three are under unittest/_torch/attention, already registered on the
B200 L0 list (tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_b200.yml), so they run
in CI on Blackwell.

📝 Walkthrough

Walkthrough

This PR introduces a behavior-layer sparse attention framework for TensorRT-LLM, implementing a multi-manager coordinator that orchestrates KV-cache compression methods alongside RocketKV two-stage sparse attention. The system dispatches lifecycle hooks deterministically across axes, validates single-source invariants, and integrates with PyExecutor to route sparse index computation through executor callbacks during context and generation phases.

Changes

Behavior-Layer Executor Framework & Coordination

Layer / File(s) Summary
Base Executor Framework & Metadata
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/interface.py, tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/kv_cache_compression_executor.py		 Introduces BaseKVCacheCompressionExecutor base class with optional lifecycle hooks, SparseAttentionExecutor sparse-specific subclass, and adds AttentionMetadata.coordinator field to route attention hooks through coordinator when present.
KV Cache Behavior Coordinator
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/coordinator.py		 Implements KVCacheBehaviorCoordinator(BaseResourceManager) that orchestrates multiple executors across axes, deduplicates request-init, detects context→generation transitions to trigger context-end, enforces deterministic HOOK_ORDER dispatch, validates single-source attention metadata, and provides introspection helpers.

RocketKV Sparse Attention Implementation

Layer / File(s) Summary
RocketKV Executor & Attention Shims
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/rocketkv.py		 Complete RocketKV implementation with Stage I-a SnapKV-style sparse KV selection (context phase), Stage I-b physical eviction rewind, and Stage II query-aware sparse mask construction (generation phase); includes attention backend shim classes for TRT-LLM and Vanilla paths.
RocketKV Attention Metadata & Prepare Logic
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/rocketkv.py (metadata classes)		 Metadata classes with prepare() logic that rewinds generation-request cached-token counts, clamps prompt lengths, constructs cumulative-length arrays and sparse-offset indices, and handles chunked-prefill accumulation and in-place override.
RocketKV Cache Manager V2 Subclass
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/rocketkv.py (RocketKVCacheManagerV2)		 KVCacheManagerV2 subclass that registers KT as a sub-page buffer role with shared K/V allocation, provides KT pool access and block-offset fill logic for executor use.
Triton Kernel Block Index Fixes
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/kernel.py		 Casts block indices to tl.int64 in three KT cache update/BMM kernels before multiplication to prevent address overflow.

Configuration, Factory Dispatch & Attention Backend Routing

Sparse Attention Configuration
tensorrt_llm/llmapi/llm_args.py, tensorrt_llm/llmapi/__init__.py		 Adds BaseSparseAttentionConfig.is_behavior_layer_method property (default False) to distinguish behavior-layer from cache-manager methods; introduces RocketKVSparseAttentionConfig with RocketKV hyperparameters and exports publicly.
Executor Factory & Coordinator Creation
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/utils.py		 Implements create_sparse_attention_manager() and create_behavior_coordinator() factories that instantiate RocketKV executors, validate KVCacheManagerV2 compatibility, and wrap in coordinator.
Attention Backend Selection & Re-exports
tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/utils.py, tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/sparse/__init__.py, tensorrt_llm/_torch/attention_backend/utils.py		 Updates sparse backend getters to route behavior-layer methods to algorithm-specific shims (rocketkv→RocketKVTrtllmAttention), clears sparse config for behavior-layer dispatch, and expands package exports.
Rope Fusion Gating
tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/attention.py		 Broadens rope fusion disabling from "rocket" alone to both "rocket" and "rocketkv" algorithms.

PyExecutor Integration & Coordinator Propagation

1026-1038: ⚠️ Potential issue | 🟠 Major | ⚡ Quick win

Propagate the split host-cache budget to the draft manager.

_split_kv_cache_budget_for_draft() splits both max_gpu_total_bytes and host_cache_size, but the two-model VSWA path only swaps max_gpu_total_bytes before constructing the draft manager. With host offload enabled, the draft still inherits the target host budget, so the split is inconsistent and can mis-size draft KV memory.

Suggested fix

             if issubclass(self._kv_cache_manager_cls, KVCacheManagerV2):
                 assert draft_kv_cache_config is None, (
                     "KVCacheManagerV2 does not support two-model speculative "
                     "decoding with separate draft KV cache budget splitting.")
             # For KVCacheManager VSWA, apply the draft's split budget temporarily
             if draft_kv_cache_config is not None:
                 saved_budget = self._kv_cache_config.max_gpu_total_bytes
+                saved_host_budget = self._kv_cache_config.host_cache_size

+                self._kv_cache_config.host_cache_size = draft_kv_cache_config.host_cache_size
             draft_kv_cache_manager = self._create_kv_cache_manager(

[feat] Sparse-attention framework + V2-migrated RocketKV with chunked…
1c08c21 
… prefill

Adds a behavior-layer sparse-attention framework and the first method built on
it: a KVCacheManagerV2-migrated RocketKV (algorithm="rocketkv") with chunked
prefill support, coexisting with the legacy V1 path (algorithm="rocket").

Framework:
- KVCacheBehaviorCoordinator: owns N compression executors (one per axis:
  sparse / storage / cross_request) and fans PyExecutor BaseResourceManager
  callbacks (prepare/update/free_resources) out to 6 semantic hooks.
- BaseKVCacheCompressionExecutor / SparseAttentionExecutor base classes.
- Minimal adaptation outside the sparse package: AttentionMetadata.coordinator
  field, the HOOK 2/4 call site in TrtllmAttention.forward (gated on coordinator
  presence), the KV_CACHE_BEHAVIOR_COORDINATOR resource-manager type, and the
  coordinator build/registration + metadata wiring in _util.py / model_engine.py.

RocketKV (algorithm="rocketkv"):
- 2-stage algorithm ported onto the executor hooks: Stage I-a KT landmark cache
  + Stage I-b SnapKV physical evict (on_context_end), Stage II query-aware HSA
  sparse decode (on_generation_attention).
- KT pool is V2-managed (Role.KT_CACHE BufferConfig, shares the K/V block index
  via page_index_scale); int64 block-index addressing avoids long-context /
  large-batch overflow.
- Chunked prefill: per-(request,layer) accumulation of chunk-local qkv, full-
  prefix scoring at the true last chunk, multi-request (num_contexts>1) batched.

Validated on Llama-3.1-8B B200: NIAH e2e 15 passed (incl. chunked single +
multi-request), framework unit suite 111 passed; GSM8K/MMLU parity dense ==
no-chunk == chunked; stress to 64K ctx / bs32 / 32x compression with 0 IMA.

Signed-off-by: tianruih <tianruih@nvidia.com>
